title: mHrwm - deprived

Graph connections

Root

  • Hrm - reverence

Meaning

deprived · Lemma مَحْرُوم

Surahs (4)

  • 051 Adh-Dhariyat
  • 056 Al-Waqiah
  • 068 Al-Qalam

Verses (full text)

Arabic + English (Sahih International) + Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari). Showing up to 10 verses.

51:19 · 051 Adh-Dhariyat

وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ

Word in this verse: وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ — and the deprived

English (Sahih International): And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): اور ان کے مال میں مانگنے والے اور نہ مانگنے والے (دونوں) کا حق ہوتا تھا
